summary: Guidance severity tiers shipped. Items now carry severity 'blocking'|'review' (addGuidance in lib/overlay.js; anything else/absent defaults 'blocking'). decideAll/decideOne gate: only BLOCKING pending items trigger await_user; review items never pause the loop (await_user decisions expose review_pending count). GET /guidance returns { pending: blocking[], review: review[] } — each item has .severity. POST /guidance + request_guidance MCP tool accept optional severity (default 'blocking'). Judge surfaceCluster verdicts (the actual housekeeping producer — NOTE: no surfaceSupersede verdict exists in code; task premise was stale, queue had 2 'Ambiguous duplicate cluster' items not 113 supersedes) now tagged 'review'. Lazy migration in pendingGuidance stamps legacy items whose question starts with 'Possible supersede:' or 'Ambiguous duplicate cluster' as 'review'. Dashboard (graph.html renderGuidance): amber '⏸ Loop paused' banner shows ONLY blocking items; review items render as a quiet collapsed '🗂 N to review ▸' details chip, display-only (per-item confirm/reject is task .../4). Supersedes/consolidations still NEVER auto-applied. Verified live: blocking=0/review=2, loop decision with review-only = idle (was await_user), blocking item still pauses; all 29 test files pass.
